text:
Eli: rolled out microkernel-scheduler to canary-3 this morning. Early signals: p50 down ~18%, p99 roughly flat, and cost-per-token down ~22% on LLM-8 workloads. TL;DR: kernel-variant switch + eager microbatch scheduling did the trick. 🚀

Eli: quick config we used:
```
scheduler:
  type: microkernel
  batch_window_ms: 4
  eager_flush_threshold: 0.6
  kernel_variant: compactv2
```

Eli: how we benchmarked:
```
./bench --model l8 --qps 500 --seq 512 --profile microkernel
# sample: p50 12.3ms -> 10.1ms (-18%)
# sample: token_cost 0.012 -> 0.0094 (-22%)
```

Priyanka: holy — nice! what's the impact on tail for long sequences (>1024)? any regressions?

Eli: good q. p99 on seq=2048 shows ~+3% (we saw a small bump due to compactv2 path for huge KV cache churn). we added a sequence-length guard: seq > 1500 falls back to classic kernel automatically.

Sam: can we toggle that eager_flush_threshold at runtime? 0.6 seems aggressive for some workloads.

Eli: yes, it's behind a runtime flag: `runtime.microkernel.eager_threshold`. perf matrix we ran: 0.5 -> slightly better tail, 0.7 -> best cost but p99 increased on heavy KV churn. 0.6 = best p50/cost balance.

deploy-bot: canary deployment 1805006600 completed — microkernel-scheduler enabled on 3 nodes in canary-3.

Mira: added tracing labels `microkernel=true` and `batcher=mk` to all spans; dashboards updated (eng-runtime > microkernel-scheduler).

Ashish: verified cost numbers with cost-tool: end-to-end token-cost ~22% lower when microkernel + KV prefetch enabled. Will drop a short report in the ticket.

Priyanka: OK when do we promote to prod-canary?

Eli: plan: if no regressions in next 24h, promote to prod-canary tomorrow 09:00 UTC. rollback plan: disable flag + roll kernel version back to compactv1 (takes ~5min per pool). I opened rollout ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-12345

Sam: can you add a quick note about how this interacts with batching heuristics in the docs? I can update the dev docs after promotion.

Eli: will add a short section under runtime/batching.md and link it to the ticket.

Priyanka: :thumbsup: thanks all — great win.

deploy-bot: incident-bot note: no errors >5xx observed during canary window.
